question: Does adding more Jev topic rows (all 2,560 instead of none) lower the topic abstain share of the sparse topic head on 1,000 held-out queue stories?
one_change: train the sparse topic head on the Sonnet rows plus all 2,560 Jev topic rows instead of the Sonnet rows alone

baseline.model: sparse topic head on the Sonnet rows alone, T144 queue held-out topic abstain share

prediction.metric: topic abstain share (top-two mass under 0.70) on 1,000 held-out queue stories, head trained with all 2,560 Jev rows
prediction.why: T144 recorded a topic abstain share of 0.087 with no Jev rows and 0.078 with 1,600 rows on the same 1,000 stories; the expected value with 2,560 rows is near 0.075, with a spread of 0.01 from the story sample
